oneLiner: Ask which startup credits, programs and perks fit your company, answered from checked records with official sources.
description:
Programscape is an independent map of startup credits, programs and perks: cloud and AI credits, accelerator
programs and product discounts from AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, Stripe and more.
Every record carries its official source and the date it was last checked. Providers can't pay for placement.

Tell Claude your stage, your funding, the tools you use and what kind of company you are. It returns the review
Programscape would show you: the programs worth your time now, the question that settles each one, and what can
wait and why. It reports each program's standing as it is. It never says you qualify, because the provider
decides. It never adds amounts into a total, and it never picks a winning provider.

Searching, comparing and building a review work without an account. To keep a plan, sign in to Programscape once
with an email code or Google. There's no password. Claude can then read your saved plan, save your answers and the
programs you choose and the application progress you report when you ask, and pick up where you left off next
time. When more than one plan is available, you choose which company to read or update. Programscape can email you when a
program you kept changes its terms, or when a new one fits.

Provider balances you report for a kept, approved program are saved in the provider's unit, with when they were
read and who reported them. Balances are separate from awards and are never totalled.

If you joined your venture firm's or studio's perks through its Programscape invite link, Claude shows those deals
in their own section, labelled as the partner's terms. Only that list's admins can ask what needs a look on it.
reviewerCompanySelection: For an account with several plans, an unselected my_plan returns an MCP tool result with isError:true and structuredContent.selectionRequired:true, with named plan choices. Inspect those structured choices, ask which company the founder means, retain previously cached plan data, then retry with the selected planId. Use that id for later reads and writes.
